title: Caelyn Sandel and Grahu-Rubufo - Teaching the Fun of Losing
speaker: Caelyn Sandel and Grahu-Rubufo
description:
This talk is from the 2020 virtual Roguelike Celebration:
https://roguelike.club/event2020.html

Caelyn Sandel is an experimental author and narrative designer living in the greater Boston area. In addition to contributing writing and design to Caves of Qud, she also voices Grahu-Rubufo, Learned Snapjaw VTuber.

Roguelikes are hard, and everyone knows it. Within a genre that prides itself on steep learning curves, there isn't much discussion of onboarding new players in spite of the glut of new roguelikes all seeking a growing audience. Although game difficulty and accessibility have become an ongoing discussion among devs and players alike, most such discussions have been tragically polarized. What does it look like to make new players comfortable? How do you figure out what unintended messages you're sending to new players? In this talk, Caelyn will tell you - with a bit of help from Grahu-Rubufo herself!

Find Caelyn on Twitter: https://twitter.com/inurashii
Follow Gra on Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/inurashii
Get Caves of Qud: https://store.steampowered.com/app/333640/Caves_of_Qud/
